title: The Life Faculty
html:

  • 3. Chaḷindriyavagga 3. The Six Faculties

Jīvitindriyasutta The Life Faculty

“Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, indriyāni. “Mendicants, there are these three faculties. Katamāni tīṇi? What three? Itthindriyaṁ, purisindriyaṁ, jīvitindriyaṁ—The faculties of femininity, masculinity, and life. imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi indriyānī”ti. These are the three faculties.”

Dutiyaṁ.
